hero.intro: I'm Mohammed Ashraf, a designer and full-stack developer running a one-person design, code and AI studio. I take a project from the first mark to the last automation, so nothing gets lost between an agency, a freelancer and a developer.

contact.title: One point of contact
contact.body: You talk to the person doing the work. No account managers, no briefs lost in translation.

craft.title: Design and code in one head
craft.body: The identity, the interface and the code are decided together, so what you approve is what ships.

evidence.title: Evidence over guesswork
evidence.body: Scope, timelines and AI results are measured, written down and checked, not promised.
